answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the grove bond on all of them and exposing each to the canyon slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 3 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the tide audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Each impostor pays 5 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
